name: Surface-Aware Policies
description: Per-surface policies for every AI tool. Chat surfaces (Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT) cannot exec or write. Dev tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Windsurf) get full access. Codex Desktop gets a warning tier.

surfaces.claude-code: Claude Code CLI — developer terminal, full access
surfaces.claude-ai: Claude.ai web — chat surface, no exec or write
surfaces.claude-desktop: Claude Desktop app (Chat / Work / Teams) — no exec or write
surfaces.codex-cli: OpenAI Codex CLI — developer terminal, full access
surfaces.codex-desktop: OpenAI Codex Desktop app — warn on exec, no raw deletes
surfaces.openai-chatgpt: ChatGPT (web / desktop) — chat surface, no exec or write
surfaces.cursor: Cursor IDE — developer tool, full access
surfaces.windsurf: Windsurf IDE — developer tool, full access

rules.description: Block shell execution from chat surfaces — Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT
rules.message: Shell commands are not permitted from chat surfaces. Use Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, or Windsurf for terminal access.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks the matching action only on surfaces marked hard or conditional when their listed dependencies are satisfied.
requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action
known_limitations: Hook enforcement depends on the AI tool emitting supported structured hook events
MCP guard_check does not evaluate match_ai_tool
Workflow runtime skips rules restricted to non-workflow tool families
